name: plate vambraces
_design_note: F50-100 heavy arms slot. Full articulated plate, elbow couter and forearm rerebrace. Pairs with plate/full plate body. Vambraces_of_Achilles uses this as template_basis.
lore_template: Full {material_name} plate vambraces with a hinged elbow couter and a fluted rerebrace covering the upper forearm. Together with the plate gauntlets they create an unbroken metal sheath from fingertip to shoulder — and a smith's signature is somewhere on the inside seam, where the wearer will probably never look.
